title: Minimum Specification Perturbation: Robustness as Distance-to-Falsification in Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.01579v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Empirical causal claims depend on many analyst decisions, from selecting covariates to choosing estimators. Existing robustness tools summarize how results vary across these choices, but, to the best of our knowledge, do not answer: \textbf{How many analyst decisions must change to reach a specification, which is a set of choices, whose confidence interval (CI) contains zero?} We introduce \emph{Minimum Specification Perturbation (MSP)}, the smallest number of changes. MSP is small under the null, grows with effect strength and captures distance-to-falsification information that dispersion-based summaries cannot report; when making decisions under weak effects, an MSP-based rule yields lower false-positive rates than dispersion-based rules. We show that Fragility Index and MSP measure orthogonal vulnerabilities: fragility to influential observations need not imply fragility to specification choices. On the LaLonde benchmark, MS

translated_title: 最小设定扰动：作为因果推断中“达到证伪距离”的稳健性度量
translated_abstract: 经验性因果结论依赖于研究者的诸多决策，从协变量的选取到估计量的选择。现有的稳健性工具总结结果在这些不同选择间的变化情况，但据我们所知，它们并未回答这样一个问题：**需要改变多少个研究者的决策，才能得到一个其置信区间（CI）包含零的设定（即一组选择）？**我们提出了*最小设定扰动*，即所需的最小变更次数。MSP在原假设下较小，并随效应强度的增大而增长，能够捕捉基于离散度的汇总指标所无法反映的“达到证伪的距离”信息；在弱效应情形下做决策时，基于MSP的规则相比基于离散度的规则具有更低的假阳性率。我们证明脆弱指数与MSP衡量的是相互正交的脆弱性：对有影响观测值的脆弱性并不必然意味着对设定选择的脆弱性。在LaLonde基准数据上，MS（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出最小设定扰动（MSP）指标，量化需要改变多少个研究者的分析决策才能使结果置信区间包含零，从而将稳健性理解为“达到证伪的距离”，该指标与脆弱指数及基于离散度的稳健性度量相互正交、互为补充。
en_tdlr: Proposes Minimum Specification Perturbation (MSP), which counts the minimum number of analyst decisions that must change for a specification's confidence interval to contain zero, reframing robustness as distance-to-falsification and showing it captures vulnerabilities orthogonal to both the Fragility Index and dispersion-based summaries.
